title: Effect of a paired-tape cleaning action
statement: Let the two tape banks each have $k$ tapes, and let a configuration have input $x$, state $st$, input-head position $ip$, tape contents $D_t,M_t$, head positions $D_p,M_p$, and output $out$. For a tape index $i$, write instructions $w_D,w_M$, movement sign $mv$, and successor state $st'$, applying the cleaning action gives state $st'$, the same input-head position and output, and updates only tape $i$ in each bank: its contents become the result of applying the respective write instruction at its current head position, and its head position increases by $mv$.
hypotheses_covered: $k$ is a natural number and $S$ is a state type
$i$ is a tape index among the $k$ tapes
$w_D,w_M$ are optional write instructions, each optionally specifying a bit or blank
$D_t,M_t$ are tape-content functions and $D_p,M_p$ are head-position functions
